story_zh: 今天，办公室的同事小李需要帮忙。经理要求他完成一份报告，但他要请假。我决定带他去见经理。经理同意他请假，并认为这是个好机会。我们用电子邮件发送了报告。会议后，我完成了所有要求。
story_pinyin: Jīntiān, bàngōngshì de tóngshì Xiǎo Lǐ xūyào bāngmáng. Jīnglǐ yāoqiú tā wánchéng yī fèn bàogào, dàn tā yào qǐngjià. Wǒ juédìng dài tā qù jiàn jīnglǐ. Jīnglǐ tóngyì tā qǐngjià, bìng rènwéi zhè shì gè hǎo jīhuì. Wǒmen yòng diànzǐ yóujiàn fāsòngle bàogào. Huìyì hòu, wǒ wánchéngle suǒyǒu yāoqiú.
story_en: Today, my colleague Xiao Li in the office needs help. The manager asked him to complete a report, but he needs to ask for leave. I decided to take him to see the manager. The manager agreed to his leave and thought it was a good opportunity. We used email to send the report. After the meeting, I completed all the requirements.
